I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I thanked her for the correction and told her I can't keep records between conversations, so the 10 June renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. won't be saved on my side. I suggested she post the correction in #north-team next to her original message so the team sees it there.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't touch #north-team or anything else.
